origin.daisy_smp.copper_golem.name: Copper golem
origin.daisy_smp.copper_golem.descriptio: A small, curious construct of living copper, drawn to metal and simple tasks.
power.daisy_smp.size/1_5_block.name: Shoulder height
power.daisy_smp.size/1_5_block.descripti: You are only one and a half blocks tall.
You can only eat things made of copper.
power.daisy_smp.copper_golem/magnet.name: Magnetic
power.daisy_smp.copper_golem/magnet.desc: You can activate your magnet ability to collect items around you automatically.
power.daisy_smp.enderian/inverted_view.d: You view the colors like an enderman would.
power.daisy_smp_tweaks.likely_to_be_hit_: During thunder storms you have a likely chance of being struck by lightning.
origin.daisy_smp.piglin.name: Nether piggy
origin.daisy_smp.piglin.description: A hardened wanderer of the Nether, bound by gold and instinct.
power.daisy_smp.piglin/golden_stuff_boos: Gold armor and tools' durability depletes slower, and they are more effective.
power.daisy_smp.piglin/crossbow_master.d: Your favorite weapon is a crossbow, you deal more damage with it.
power.daisy_smp.piglin/piglin_neutrality: Your own kind loves you. They are not bothered by your presence.
power.daisy_smp.general/homesick.name: Homesick
power.daisy_smp.general/homesick.descrip: Being away from the nether makes you feel weak.
power.daisy_smp.piglin/golden_gluttony.d: You can only eat things made of gold and meat.
power.daisy_smp.health/2_less_hearts.des: You have two less hearts than a normal player.
power.daisy_smp.piglin/soul_spooked.name: Soul spooked
power.daisy_smp.piglin/soul_spooked.desc: You get weakness around certain blocks your kind dislikes.
origin.daisy_smp.moobloom.name: Moobloom
origin.daisy_smp.moobloom.description: A mushroom-covered creature, happily wandering and spreading a bit of nature wherever it goes.
power.daisy_smp.moobloom/better_mushroom: Mushroom stew fills you up more than any other foods.
power.daisy_smp.moobloom/eat_flowers.des: Eat different flower and see what happens.
power.daisy_smp.moobloom/infestation.des: Turn dirts into mycellium, watch your hunger!
power.daisy_smp.moobloom/red_green_color: You confuse red and green. Find the special goggles to see normally.
Every five minutes you shed a brown or red mushroom, use it to make some stew!
power.daisy_smp.general/no_sleep.name: Insomnia
power.daisy_smp.general/no_sleep.descrip: You can't sleep, might be because you can't or you don't need it.
power.daisy_smp.general/vegan.name: Vegetarian
power.daisy_smp.general/vegan.descriptio: Your diet is restricted to vegetables, no meat for you!
origin.daisy_smp.breezeborn.name: Breezeborn
origin.daisy_smp.breezeborn.description: A being touched by wind itself, light as air and ever in motion.
power.daisy_smp.breezeborn/throw_wind_ch: Throw windcharges at players and entities to deal damage.
power.daisy_smp.breezeborn/more_like_air: Modifiers to your walking speed also apply while you're airborne.
power.daisy_smp.general/vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
power.daisy_smp.general/vulnerable.descr: You take more damage than the average player.
origin.daisy_smp.firefly.name: Firefly
origin.daisy_smp.firefly.description: You naturally emit light. Lighting the way everywhere you go.
power.daisy_smp.size/1_block.name: Itty bitty
power.daisy_smp.size/1_block.description: You are only one block tall.
power.daisy_smp.firefly/firefly_poop.des: You can craft a special kind of invisible light block.
power.daisy_smp.general/float.name: Floating
power.daisy_smp.general/float.descriptio: You can float, but keep an eye on that bar!
power.daisy_smp.health/4_less_hearts.des: You are so frail you have 4 less hearts than the usual player.
power.daisy_smp.firefly/hard_to_see.name: Hard to see
power.daisy_smp.firefly/hard_to_see.desc: You are so tiny mobs don't notice you unless they get up close.
origin.daisy_smp.frog.name: Frog
origin.daisy_smp.frog.description: A small, nimble creature of water and lily pads, built for leaping and life beneath the surface.
power.daisy_smp.frog/dried_up.name: Dried up
power.daisy_smp.frog/dried_up.descriptio: You take more damage when on land due to the sun drying you up. You break blocks slower, do less damage, attack slower, burn longer and take more damage from it.
power.daisy_smp.frog/lessfall.name: Light as a feather
origin.daisy_smp.snow_golem.name: Snow golem
origin.daisy_smp.snow_golem.description: A creature of living frost, shaped by winter’s will and bound to the cold.
power.daisy_smp.snow_golem/extra_fire_da: The heat of fire or lava hurts much more!
power.daisy_smp.snow_golem/dislikes_hot_: Hot biomes make you melt, ouch.
power.daisy_smp.snow_golem/likes_cold_bi: Cold biomes are so cozy, it regenerates you.
power.daisy_smp.snow_golem/throw_snowbal: You can throw snowballs at mobs and players, it knocks them back.
power.daisy_smp.snow_golem/eat_snow.name: Eat snow
power.daisy_smp.snow_golem/eat_snow.desc: Only snow makes your tummy full!
power.daisy_smp_tweaks.cant_fall_powdere: You do not sink or take damage from powdered snow.
origin.daisy_smp.happy_ghast.name: Happy ghastling
origin.daisy_smp.happy_ghast.description: A drifting spirit of the Nether, oddly cheerful despite its size and weight.
power.daisy_smp.size/4_block.name: Huge
power.daisy_smp.happy_ghast/thirst.name: Dried up
power.daisy_smp.happy_ghast/thirst.descr: You get very thirsty, stay hydrated!
origin.daisy_smp.wither_skeleton.name: Withered skeleton
origin.daisy_smp.wither_skeleton.descrip: A remnant of the Nether, forged from ash-black bone and lingering decay.
power.daisy_smp.size/2_5_block.name: Taller
origin.daisy_smp.warden.name: Skulk walker
origin.daisy_smp.warden.description: A towering being shaped by ancient echoes, moving as if the world itself listens.
power.daisy_smp.size/3_block.name: Bigger
power.daisy_smp.warden/bad_sight.name: Blindness
power.daisy_smp.warden/bad_sight.descrip: You can't really see, might be able to perceive colors better finding certain goggles.
power.daisy_smp.health/4_more_hearts.des: You are really sturdy, you have 4 more hearts than the average player.
power.daisy_smp.warden/double_damage.des: You are stronger than any average player.
power.daisy_smp.warden/hungry.name: Hunger
power.daisy_smp.warden/hungry.descriptio: Because of your size you get hungry faster.
power.daisy_smp.warden/no_elytra.name: No fly list
power.daisy_smp.warden/no_elytra.descrip: You are too heavy to use elytras.
power.daisy_smp.warden/sniff_out.name: Sniff out
power.daisy_smp.warden/sniff_out.descrip: You can press your primary key to sniff entities around you.
